text: Independent implementation review REJECTED the initial candidate (subagent:tooling_design_review, inspected evidence.js fcb427ce, cli.js 0badbdd2, configuration.js 0b26d7a0, process.js fc7194e6). Findings: observations could be rebound; component obligations and Solver review currency were incomplete; CLI preflight ran after install; unmanaged Serena project.local.yml could override settings; Context7 runtime was not bound; process descendants could outlive ownership; raw transcript embedding violated evidence-store ownership. Repairs are in progress in the shared owners and require fresh independent review. No component, pilot, landing or publication acceptance is claimed.

Independent source review required concrete observation-to-subject joins: positive tools must be current candidate executions, navigation must bind a full source digest observed in the actual session, raw failure output must link to its producing invocation, and pilot authorship/landing/lesson/publication must share identities. Implemented owner-specific applicability rather than invalidating every component for unrelated edits; Q4/Q8 still bind the admission implementation. Canonical isolated controls exercise stale source/configuration, self-review, intervening attempts, counterfeit publication input, missing committed authored bytes, unrelated lessons and commit-only landing. These controls are validator inputs only, never comparative measurements. The final independent review remains open; no approval or closure asserted.

Actual canonical seven-file run on the reviewed implementation: 173 assertions passed, including process lifetime, evidence admission, existing Solver and publisher checks. Isolated validator inputs are never campaign observations.
